authorization: User requested continued text quality and inference memory research. Bounded local CPU pilot only. Preserve function weights, learned t sampling and block layout; hierarchy changes KV storage/readout only.
hypothesis: Learned pooling can recover full-attention quality at 4x to 8x smaller KV capacity. First isolate the full-attention backbone quality against the pinned upstream nanoGPT implementation.

data.title: Alice in Wonderland, Project Gutenberg ebook 11
data.extraction: Bytes between first START marker closing *** and first END marker; no normalization. Original file and license retained.
data.split_rule: Disjoint fixed byte regions in CONFIG; no prior checkpoints used. Confirmation never used for updates, checkpoint selection or capacity choice. Repeated phrases within one book remain possible.

comparison: Both full-attention backbones trained from scratch on exactly matched batches and target exposures. Same width, layers, heads, precision, optimizer and schedule; parameter count and architecture differ and are reported. Not compute matched. Curves use RoPE; nanoGPT uses learned positions. Hierarchy receives extra training and teacher compute, explicitly reported.
pool_training: Freeze every backbone and router parameter. Optimize only hierarchy pooling directions with next-byte CE plus full-attention teacher KL. Save zero-init and all three rounds. Halve LR after a round that fails to improve selection CE. Same minibatches per seed for both capacities.
selection: Choose best round per seed/capacity by selection mean CE. Select smallest capacity with <=2% selection PPL overhead versus both full curve and nanoGPT for every seed; otherwise lowest mean selection CE, marked exploratory. Freeze all choices before confirmation.
gates: Confirmation one-sided upper paired t95 log-PPL gap and each seed gap <= log(1.02) versus both reference backbones. 4x isolated-process peak RSS reduction versus full curve at matched context is separate gate. No promotion without both. Learned pooling improvement reported versus zero-init same-capacity control.
limits: Small byte-language pilot, not SOTA reproduction. Quality only at trained128-byte context. 8192 context memory is mechanics-only extrapolation. No 70B or 100K-context quality claim. No cache-only savings called total-memory savings.
